read.thesis: Potash-led upstream recovery with record 2025 offshore volumes and 2026 global shipments guided to 74–77Mt; capex held at $2.0–2.1B and Trinidad/New Madrid nitrogen capacity exited, so supply discipline is visible.

capex.quote: Total capital expenditures of $2.0 to $2.1 billion is consistent with 2025 as we continue to optimize capital to sustain safe and reliable operations

triggers.label: Trinidad and New Madrid nitrogen capacity shut
triggers.quote: we ceased production at our New Madrid Nitrogen upgrade facility at year-end 2025
triggers.highlight: ceased production at our New Madrid Nitrogen upgrade facility

triggers.label: Global potash shipments 74–77Mt in 2026
triggers.quote: total global potash shipments ranging between 74 and 77 million tonnes
triggers.highlight: total global potash shipments ranging between 74 and 77 million tonnes

triggers.label: Potash net selling price $262 in Q4 vs $194
triggers.quote: Net selling price per tonne increased in the fourth quarter and full year of 2025 due to higher global benchmark prices.
triggers.highlight: increased in the fourth quarter and full year of 2025

triggers.label: Ammonia operating rate 92% in 2025
triggers.quote: four-percentage-point improvement in ammonia operating rate
triggers.highlight: four-percentage-point improvement in ammonia operating rate

guidance.quote: Retail adjusted EBITDA guidance of $1.75 to $1.95 billion
Potash sales volume guidance of 14.1 to 14.8 million tonnes
Nitrogen sales volume guidance of 9.2 to 9.7 million tonnes
Phosphate sales volume guidance of 2.4 to 2.6 million tonnes
Total capital expenditures of $2.0 to $2.1 billion is consistent with 2025

red_flags.label: Trinidad nitrogen controlled shutdown and port access restrictions
red_flags.quote: On October 23, 2025, the Trinidad nitrogen facility completed a controlled shutdown in response to port access restrictions

red_flags.label: Brazil affordability weakening, just-in-time buying
red_flags.quote: weaker affordability is expected to result in just-in-time purchases
